kv3.1:2.3: Tañ ñeva Tathāgatabalaṃ taṃ sāvakabalaṃ, taṃ sāvakabalaṃ taṃ Tathāgatabalan ti?
kv3.1:3.3: Yādisaṃ Tathāgatabalaṃ, tādisaṃ sāvakabalaṃ; yādisaṃ sāvakabalaṃ, tādisaṃ Tathāgatabalan ti?
kv3.1:4.3: Yādiso Tathāgatassa pubbayogo pubbacariyā, dhammakkhānaṃ dhammadesanā, tādiso sāvakassa pubbayogo pubbacariyā, dhammakkhānaṃ dhammadesanā ti?
kv3.1:5.3: Tathāgato Jino Satthā Sammāsambuddho Sabbaññū Sabbadassāvī Dhammasāmī Dhammapaṭisaraṇo ti?
kv3.1:5.5: Sāvako Jino Satthā Sammāsambuddho Sabbaññū Sabbadassāvī Dhammasāmī Dhammapaṭisaraṇo ti?
kv3.1:6.3: Tathāgato anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā maggaññū maggavidū maggakovido ti?
kv3.1:6.5: Sāvako anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā maggaññū maggavidū maggakovido ti?
kv3.1:7.1: Indriyaparopariyattaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ Tathāgatabalaṃ sāvakasādhāraṇan ti?
kv3.1:8.3: Hañci sāvako ṭhānāṭhānaṃ jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe
kv3.1:9.1: Sāvako atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ jānātīti?
kv3.1:9.3: Hañci sāvako atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe
kv3.1:9.4: "Atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ Tathāgatabalaṃ sāvakasādhāraṇan ti." 6.
kv3.1:10.3: Hañci sāvako sabbatthagāminīpaṭipadaṃ jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe
kv3.1:11.3: Hañci sāvako anekadhātuṃ nānādhātuṃ lokaṃ jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe
kv3.1:11.4: "Anekadhātuṃ nānādhātuṃ lokaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ Tathāgatabalaṃ sāvakasādhāraṇan ti." 8.
kv3.1:12.3: Hañci sāvako sattānaṃ nānādhimuttikataṃ jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe
kv3.1:12.4: "Sattānaṃ nānādhimuttikataṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ Tathāgatabalaṃ sāvakasādhāraṇan ti." 9.
kv3.1:13.1: Sāvako jhānavimokkhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṃkilesaṃ vohānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ jānātīti?
kv3.1:13.3: Hañci sāvako jhānavimokkhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṃkilesaṃ vohānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe
kv3.1:13.4: "Jhānavimokkhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṃkilesaṃ vohānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ Tathāgatabalaṃ sāvakasādhāraṇan ti." 10.
kv3.1:14.3: Hañci sāvako pubbenivāsānussatiṃ jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe
kv3.1:15.3: Hañci sāvako sattānaṃ cutūpapātaṃ jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe
kv3.1:15.4: "Sattānaṃ cutūpapātaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ Tathāgatabalaṃ sāvakasādhāraṇan ti." 12.
kv3.1:16.1: Nanu Tathāgatassāpi āsavā khīṇā, sāvakassāpi āsavā khīṇā ti?
kv3.1:16.3: Atthi kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ Tathāgatassa vā sāvakassa vā āsavakkhayena vā āsavakkhayaṃ vimuttiyā vā vimuttīti?
kv3.1:16.5: Hañci n' atthi kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ Tathāgatassa vā sāvākassa vā āsavakkhayena vā āsavakkhayaṃ vimuttiyā vā vimutti, tena vata re vattabbe
